pairs.evidence: src/__tests__/api/pipeline-artifacts-drain.test.ts:15 The drain route's lock test mocks `@/lib/test-gate-runner` and swaps in a hand-written copy of `parseDrainFilter`. The real function in `src/lib/test-gate-runner/drain.ts:51` has since added `entityIds` parsing and normalises `tier` through `parseTier`.
